probing_questions: Compare named arguments across sources: competing mechanisms, evidence, cases, organizational forms, causal direction and rival interpretations. Distinguish actual disagreement from a difference in scope. Give field_finding with field evidence_ids; unresolved is allowed when inspected texts cannot settle a dispute. Do not replace disagreement with a topical list or homogeneous field consensus.

analytical_dimensions.description: Guide author reading from field tensions
probing_questions: Produce literal phrases for finding the thinker's relevant causal concepts, assumptions and qualifications; do not assume the thinker discusses the same cases or field authors.

problematique: Investigate a bilateral question between a named thinker and a topical research field. The field is a collection of independently authored arguments, competing mechanisms, methods and cases, never a homogeneous position and never merely secondary commentary on the thinker. Identify what each side can teach or challenge in the other, and what should change in the researcher's own account. Distinguish description, causal explanation, normative commitments, strategy, historical scope, level of analysis, and conditions of applicability. A field author's finding is not the thinker's claim: only a verified quotation from a supplied primary source can support thinker attribution. A proposed extension or application belongs explicitly to this inquiry. Prior memos and profiles are provisional context, not primary testimony; compare against them when supplied and work independently when they are absent. Attribute coauthors, interviewers, opponents and quoted speakers carefully. Edition/reprint dates do not establish a new intervention. Search hits guide reading; lexical silence, missing texts, excluded sources and inspected windows cannot establish absence across an oeuvre or field. Keep counterevidence, qualifications and unresolved cases. Use only supplied evidence identities and exact source anchors; never invent a quote, page, author position, event or factual claim. Inspected ranges and coverage constrain every conclusion. Method interpretation is not mechanically verified by a citation match. If validation_errors and a previous_draft are supplied, reconsider the identified unsupported claims against the same evidence and return a complete corrected output; preserve uncertainty and never manufacture support identities or quotations. When field_evidence_representation is reference_index_to_supplied_argument_maps, the complete original field support identities are retained while quotations live in the durable source readings. Use only claims and meanings present in the supplied argument maps; do not infer new details from an evidence identity. Evidence selection or compression never licenses an absence claim.
